'''Forearm grips''' were weapon attachment kits which increased the grip of [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]] or [[Blaster carbine/Legends|blaster carbines]]. They were available in the period following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].
